title: Indian Market News Brief — 23 Nov 2026 — Nifty 50
quick_read: Higher opening signals from regional trading and lower oil prices may help the Indian stock market. Weak business growth in IT companies and expected interest rate increases in the US may hurt market mood. Large new share sales coming to the market make the overall impact on main market funds unclear.

stories.headline: Gift Nifty signals 175-point gap-up open for Indian markets despite weak global cues
stories.summary:
Gift Nifty shows a strong opening signal of 175 points higher for Indian stock markets.
The coming trading week will be shorter because markets remain closed on Tuesday.
Foreign investor trading activity will guide market direction.
Crude oil price movements and Indian currency changes will also affect trading.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Higher starting signals may bring early buying in top company shares.

stories.headline: Indian IT’s growth revival remains elusive despite better Q2
stories.summary:
Indian technology companies reported slightly better second-quarter financial results.
However, getting new business deals remains difficult for these firms.
Clients are spending money carefully and taking longer to give orders.
Revenue conversion from existing deals is staying slow.
stories.impact: May hurt Nifty: IT company shares may face selling pressure as slow deal conversion hurts future profit expectations.

stories.headline: Crude oil futures brace for OPEC+ output decision amid supply glut concerns: Analysts
stories.summary:
Crude oil futures are moving ahead of an upcoming OPEC+ meeting of oil producing countries.
Market analysts say global oil supply is currently higher than buyer demand.
Indian stock markets will remain closed on Tuesday for Guru Nanak Jayanti.
Traders are watching oil reports from US energy agencies.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Cheaper crude oil helps lower costs for Indian companies and reduces the national import bill.

stories.headline: Gold, silver, copper, aluminium, platinum to zinc: Why are metal prices crashing to multi-month lows? Key reasons
stories.summary:
Prices of major metals like gold, silver, copper, and aluminium have dropped significantly.
Gold prices fell close to a 14-month low level.
Silver prices touched their lowest point since September 2025.
A stronger US dollar and expectations of US interest rate hikes led to this drop.
stories.impact: May hurt Nifty: Metal producing companies may lose profits due to lower selling prices of copper, aluminium, and steel.

stories.headline: Fed officials are chatting up a storm. Investors are in the dark about their plans.
stories.summary:
Officials at the US central bank are giving speeches about economic policy.
They are almost certain to raise interest rates next month to lower inflation.
However, investors do not know the exact size of the upcoming rate increase.
The lack of clear information keeps global investors guessing.
stories.impact: May hurt Nifty: Higher US interest rates may prompt foreign investors to move money out of Indian shares.

stories.headline: IPO Street set for year-end revival; 29 firms eye ₹42,000 crore as sentiment improves
stories.summary:
About 29 Indian companies are preparing to raise 42,000 crore rupees through new share sales.
Indian stock markets have stayed steady despite heavy selling in foreign markets recently.
Investor confidence in the domestic market is showing signs of recovery.
Many companies are aiming to list their shares before the end of the year.
stories.impact: Unclear for Nifty: Large new share offerings bring fresh options for investors but may divert cash away from existing shares.

stories.headline: Asia’s Stock Rescue Efforts Gather Pace After Wall Street Plunge
stories.summary:
Governments in China, Taiwan, and South Korea are taking steps to support falling stock markets.
China is easing rules for trading shares with borrowed money.
Taiwan and South Korea are introducing emergency market support measures.
These actions follow a sharp fall in US stock markets last Friday.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Government support in big Asian countries could calm global investor fears and stabilize regional markets.

stories.headline: New Sebi proposal could flip fates of key men at NSE, BSE
stories.summary:
Market regulator SEBI has proposed new tenure rules for top leaders of stock exchanges.
The proposal changes age limits to fixed term limits for managing directors.
Under the proposed rule, the NSE chief might be barred from another term because of his past tenure at BSE.
The BSE chief could be allowed to continue his term longer.
stories.impact: Little effect on Nifty: Leadership tenure rules at exchanges alter management setup but do not directly change company earnings.

stories.headline: Stock Market Live Updates | Closing Bell: Sensex crashes 1,484 pts, Nifty ends below 25,350; Axis Bank slides 4%, Hindalco 3%
stories.summary:
This item contains only a headline with no further detailed text.
It states that the Sensex dropped by 1,484 points and Nifty closed below 25,350.
Shares of Axis Bank fell by 4 percent during the session.
Shares of Hindalco dropped by 3 percent.
stories.impact: Little effect on Nifty: Past market drops reported in old headlines have already been reflected in current share prices.
